name: career-job-engine
description: Career Job Engine: Cloudflare Worker (D1) and React dashboard. Free tier only.

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: node --import ./test/register.mjs --test test/worker.test.mjs test/discovery.test.mjs test/listing.test.mjs test/assessment.test.mjs test/clients.test.mjs test/site.test.mjs test/bundle-privacy.test.mjs && node test_dst_transitions.js && node test_authed_fetch_regression.js && python3 test_migration_chain.py
scripts.test:worker: node --import ./test/register.mjs --test test/worker.test.mjs test/discovery.test.mjs test/listing.test.mjs test/assessment.test.mjs test/clients.test.mjs test/site.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:worker && npm test
